question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted now as a sessions.list-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for the broader sessions.activity Gateway contract?
rationale: The feature is coherent and has an implementation candidate, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, and attention state is a product/API sequencing choice that automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Accept staged builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its conflicts, review blockers, and proof to clear before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for activity API
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader sessions.activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer source of truth.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Have https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing after preserving this issue's concrete agent-status requirements there.

recommendation.title: Accept staged builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its conflicts, review blockers, and proof to clear before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest current-main owner signal for the sessions.list/status code and is assigned to the broader sessions.activity contract issue.
